verdict: Yes. Adil Qadri from Bilimora pitched perfumes and attars on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal, with one of the strongest revenue figures in personal care. Attars have a loyal following, and online sales and creators have made fragrances a major D2C category.
angle: Attars are alcohol-free and long-lasting, and popular for religious occasions and gifting. Kannauj, Lucknow and Hyderabad have attar-making traditions. Social media and live selling work well.
